instruction: Change the IMAP server port from 994 to 993 for the mail account.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing IMAP port from 994 to 993. The evaluator checks if mail.server.server1.port is set to 993. Original profile has port=994, so this requires modification. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) from VM
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and checks if mail.server.server1.port equals 993
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter (named 'rule') as the rules dict directly, no incorrect patterns
Expected value (port=993) is semantically correct and matches instruction requirement
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing port to 993, evaluator verifies port is 993
Data flow is correct: VM file -> parse prefs -> check specific preference key -> compare value

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
